usage: TEMPLATE -- copy this file, replace EVERY EXAMPLE value with the real framework observation, then REMOVE the 'template' and 'usage' fields. Every observation_source must be the Android framework's own report (adb shell getprop / dumpsys or the framework's own callbacks), never an ADCOS re-derivation. platform_events must be the ORDERED authoritative platform events (non-decreasing instants); snapshot_basis names which event produced each pre/post snapshot (the snapshots must genuinely derive from the recorded events' observations). The optional apk block {name, sha256} is deliberately absent: the current design is pure-stdlib Python on the handset with NO APK; record its absence honestly rather than fabricating provenance.
